scientific_integrity: Classical birthday/Rayleigh results and uniform spanning-tree counting are explicitly credited. Exact finite checks supplement, but do not replace, the all-n proof. Independent assessment has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns uniform frontier-edge growth on K_{2,n} rooted at a hub and comparisons only to uniform spanning trees of that graph; no general graph conclusion or historical priority certification.
title: A birthday bridge and a Gaussian–Rayleigh root-degree law for \(K_{2,n}\)
